title: The lost-state accident, and surviving it

videos.script: One morning the state file is empty. {{empty}} Nothing in Azure changed. The resource group is there, the app is serving. But Terraform's record of what it built says nothing was built. {{record}} Its next plan offers to create everything again, and fails, or worse, succeeds beside the old. {{plan}} This lesson breaks the state on purpose, restores it from a snapshot, and then asks what you do when no copy survived. {{end}}
